title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: redesigned on-device admin settings
summary: Hold: the licensing guidance omits Microsoft's qualification that existing Teams Rooms legacy licences remain valid. The automation gaps also need narrower wording: Learn documents a configuration-update cmdlet, although the underlying Graph device-management APIs are deprecated and no longer supported.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Teams Rooms Pro Management portal > Rooms > device > Settings reaches the page for remotely configuring a room device.
claims.quote: Go to Rooms/ Phones in the left navigation and click the device you want to configure. Select the Settings tab in the device panel. Use the left navigation in the device panels to browse settings categories (About, Account, Meetings, Device, Network, etc.).
claims.fix: The path correctly stops on the settings page. Add to controls[0].note: 'From Settings, select the relevant settings category (About, Account, Meetings, Device or Network) and modify the desired setting.' The full route is Rooms > device > Settings > category > setting, as described at the cited URL.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API or automation for changing these Teams Rooms on Android device settings remotely.
claims.quote: Update the navigation property configuration in teamwork; -TeamworkDeviceId <string>; -TeamsClientConfiguration <IMicrosoftGraphTeamworkTeamsClientConfiguration>; [IsBluetoothBeaconingEnabled <Boolean?>]: True if Bluetooth beaconing is enabled.
claims.fix: Keep api null rather than recommending unsupported automation, but qualify the gap in controls[0].note and replace the no-API sentence with: 'Learn retains documentation for Update-MgBetaTeamworkDeviceConfiguration, including Bluetooth beaconing and hiding meeting names. The underlying Graph teamworkDevice APIs are deprecated and no longer supported after November 2025; this is not supported automation for the redesign.' Cite the cmdlet URL and https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/teamworkdeviceconfiguration?view=graph-rest-beta.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: On the Teams Rooms on Android console, Teams Admin Settings > Meetings > Show meeting names controls whether meeting names show.
claims.quote: On a Teams Rooms on Android device, open Teams Admin Settings > Meetings and toggle Show meeting names to Off to hide meeting names on the Teams Rooms device.
claims.fix: Add to controls[1].note: 'The home-screen guidance documents this Android toggle, while the Teams Rooms licence comparison lists Show meeting names under Pro only.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-licensing alongside the existing home-screen reference to disclose the different licensing presentation.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented API or automation for the meeting-name setting.
claims.quote: Update the navigation property configuration in teamwork; [FeaturesConfiguration <IMicrosoftGraphTeamworkFeaturesConfiguration>]: teamworkFeaturesConfiguration; [IsHideMeetingNamesEnabled <Boolean?>]: True if hiding meeting names is enabled.
claims.fix: Keep api null because the underlying API is no longer supported, but add to controls[1].note: 'Learn documents IsHideMeetingNamesEnabled through Update-MgBetaTeamworkDeviceConfiguration, but the underlying Graph teamworkDevice APIs are deprecated and no longer supported after November 2025.' Replace the blanket no-API prose as specified for controls[0].api; cite the cmdlet URL and https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/teamworkdeviceconfiguration?view=graph-rest-beta.

claims.claim: The checklist tells administrators to record Require passcode for all meetings and Bluetooth beaconing, but neither has a corresponding control row.

Narrow that step to 'Record the current value of Show meeting names in Teams Admin Settings on a representative Teams Rooms on Android device.' Do not add control rows as part of this correction.
